query:
-- 查看 PSA10 記錄中 jpyPrice 的分佈（找出異常低價）
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN jpyPrice IS NULL THEN 'NULL'
    WHEN jpyPrice < 5000 THEN 'Under 5000 JPY'
    WHEN jpyPrice < 10000 THEN '5000-10000 JPY'
    WHEN jpyPrice < 20000 THEN '10000-20000 JPY'
    WHEN jpyPrice < 50000 THEN '20000-50000 JPY'
    WHEN jpyPrice < 100000 THEN '50000-100000 JPY'
    ELSE 'Over 100000 JPY'
  END as price_range,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  MIN(CAST(price AS DECIMAL)) as min_hkd,
  MAX(CAST(price AS DECIMAL)) as max_hkd,
  AVG(CAST(price AS DECIMAL)) as avg_hkd
FROM priceHistory
WHERE grade IN ('PSA10', 'PSA 10')
GROUP BY price_range
ORDER BY MIN(jpyPrice);
